content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 to 6)
DOTTY POLYGONS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation is about the number of dots in shapes that are regular polygons.
For any polygon
\(\bullet p\) is the number of sides \(\bullet n\) is the number of dots on one side \(\bullet\) there are the same number of dots on each side.
